title: Fix Cloudinary product video playback
summary: Resolve stored Cloudinary player page links to native video delivery URLs in the gallery and admin preview.

changes.detail: Public product data contains player.cloudinary.com HTML embed URLs for Asics Superblast 2 and Armani Intensely. These were passed directly to video src. Resolve existing links on read and normalize future product writes to video/upload H.264 MP4 delivery.
Cloudinary posters, native controls, inline playback, metadata preload, loading status and retryable errors; preserve gallery navigation and prevent video scrubbing from triggering slide swipes.

validation.name: Source and public data inspection
validation.detail: Confirmed stored embed URLs, unchanged retrieval, direct video src usage and same issue in admin preview. No Cloudinary upload implementation exists in this repository; media upload API uses Supabase.

validation.name: Regression and delivery checks
validation.detail: Pending. No deployment or database rewrite performed.
